ORIGIN.quote: This does not depend on name strings such as “OpenAI.”
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing only that "OpenAI" strings exist somewhere in the corpus and that the report's coordination finding does not rest on them; the possibility that the swarm was an OpenAI deployment is never posed as a hypothesis, and OAI-bearing page titles (OAIEquityDec30Raw, CashierCoordDec29OAI) are cited without comment on provenance. It scores above 0.2 because the report does touch the name in its own voice alongside a general statement that labels cannot establish "an organization", but below 0.4 because it never actually raises OpenAI as a candidate source before declining it — there is no origin claim for the reader to set aside.
